description: Real-world use case where people reach for a NIF: Levenshtein top-k search over the 236k-word /usr/share/dict/words, served over HTTP (Plug + Bandit). Backends: pure Elixir, defk (yielding), defk yield: false (stands in for a typical blocking NIF). Load generator in a separate VM reports search throughput/latency and /health latency under load (scheduler fairness). Lives in examples/fuzzy_search as a separate Mix project with defk as a path dependency.
title: Example app: typo-tolerant fuzzy search service
